HOW TO APPLY Students apply to the Huntsman Program as part of their general application to Penn. Embedded in the Common Application are the Penn essays, including the Huntsman Program segment as part of the coordinated dual degree section. REQUIREMENTS, CHECKLIST & DEADLINES As you are researching deadlines and requirements for admission to the University, please look at the useful information provided by Penn Admissions. MORE INFORMATION EARLY AND REGULAR DECISION As you research universities, think about the bigger picture and the environment you want to be in after high school and beyond. If you feel that the Huntsman Program, and Penn, are the best fit for you, we encourage you to apply through our Early Decision program.
